definitions.explanation: The area of a baseball field within the baselines, or the players who defend that area.

examples.japanese: {内野|ないや}ゴロ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アウト→アウト：00007_auto⟧になった。
examples.english: He was out on an infield grounder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内野手|ないやしゅ}→内野手：25025_naiyashu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧{捕球|ほきゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The infielder quickly caught the ball.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内野|ないや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: He is good at infield defense.

notes:
{内野|ないや} refers to the diamond-shaped area of a baseball field enclosed by the baselines. It also refers collectively to the players who defend this area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{内野手|ないやしゅ}→内野手：25025_naiyashu⟧ (infielder)
- {内野|ないや}ゴロ (infield grounder)
- {内野|ないや}⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧ (infield fly)
- {内野|ないや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧ (infield defense)

INFIELD POSITIONS:
- ⟦{一塁手|いちるいしゅ}→一塁手：27488_ichiruishu⟧ (first baseman)
- {二塁手|にるいしゅ} (second baseman)
- {三塁手|さんるいしゅ} (third baseman)
- {遊撃手|ゆうげきしゅ} (shortstop)
